redFirst.basis: gate-only task with expectRedFirst false, and the reds the brief asks for are browser-gate reds, which the house red-first helper does not read. Proved by hand instead: I edited the browser gate first, then ran it against HEAD's committed acme-store artifact before changing any product code. It exited 1 with 'REPORT IS INERT: 9 interaction(s) did not work'. Quoted lines: R10 (med) - 'FAIL ph1 resting stack on a phone held sideways (More filters shut), scrolled into the table at 844x390, pins no more than the strip and the shut filter bar (293px against a 149.5px bound = strip 48.4 + bar 99.1 + slack 2; 75% of the screen)' and 'FAIL ph1 resting stack on a phone held sideways (More filters shut) leaves the table at least 0.5 of the screen it is read on (293px pinned against a 195px ceiling = 0.5 of 390px; 75% of the screen)'. R11 (med) - 'FAIL cl10 More filters counts a filter exactly while one of its own controls is on: got ... data-ts=blocked (More filters says "· 1" with 0 of its own controls on) · data-ts=done (...)'. R13 - 'FAIL nw1 at 1512x945 the resting count does not wrap the filter bar onto another line ("5 of 7 phases (Active & pending)": 92px with it, 60px without)'. R14 - 'FAIL es2 after Show all phases the keyboard is on the View select, not on the hidden button (active:data-tev=before-recording)' and 'FAIL es1 after the Clear inside the empty state ...'. The baseline gate on HEAD's own artifact, run before any edit, had exited 0 with 231 checks, so these reds are the new checks firing and not a broken tree. After the fix the same artifact, re-rendered, passed 239 checks. A first wording of cl10 also fired on the All-time preset, which lights a chip and filters nothing; the check was moved past the loop's turned-on-nothing branch.

outcome.technical: R10 (med): forced-colors.css - the top bar's unpin rule (.topbar{position:static}; :root{--topbar-h:0px}) moved out of the 52rem block into its own @media (max-width:52rem),(max-height:32rem) block, with the reason comment inside it. pinnedPx() already reads the computed position, so no JS changed beyond its comment. Gate: stackOverTable() and judgeStack() take a size, and the ceiling is computed per size. A sideways phone, PHONE_LANDSCAPE = PHONE_TALL rotated (844x390), runs the shut half. Measured 293px pinned (75%) before and 148px (38%) after. The open half is not run sideways, because above 52rem More filters opens as a layer hung off the bar, not as the bar growing (said in a comment). NOT fixed: the iPad-portrait wrap (834x1194, bar 122->160px, 13% of that screen). The brief allowed unpin-or-compact, and I took unpin, which bounds the share whatever the labels' length. R11 (med): page-state.js - the task-status axis is counts:false, and the `counts` doc now says the badge counts axes with a control inside the panel. rx9 in test_render_report.py is updated in step (counts false, scope not usage). New gate case cl10, in the Clear block: for every control that filters, the badge is non-empty exactly while a pressed chip or a filled field inside .fdetails is on. Clear is still offered for task-status chips (cl1 green). R12: filters.js counts matching cancelled tasks in drawn phases (nLeftOut/visX) and names them: '... · 40 of 1451 tasks, 4 cancelled matches'. The gate's basis check now derives the cancelled count off the page, as rows matching by their own text or by their phase's text with the match badge left out, and holds the clause to it in both directions. A new search-a-cancelled-task check skips on plans with none, through a FEATURE_ABSENT note; it ran green on this repo's live plan. R13: the counter says '5 of 7 phases in view' rather than repeating the View select's wording in brackets, so no nested brackets and no repetition of the select beside it. I deviated from 'a short view name' because the short names that fit ('active', a first word) would misname the Active & pending view, and 'Active & pending' alone still wrapped (224px wanted, about 173 free). Wording alone did not stop the wrap on the large demo (four status chips) or the live plan (Sort select), so controls.css changes too: #audit-q is flex:1 1 9rem with max-width 15rem (lifted to none in the 40rem phone block, where it takes the full row), and #audit-count is flex:1 1 6rem;min-width:0;line-height:1.25, so short of room the count wraps its own words inside the row's height. New gate case nw1 measures .sectools at 1512x945 with and without the count's text. Before: 92 vs 60. After: 60/60 on acme, demo-large and the live plan. The c5b pin was updated, and a new c5d pins the cancelled-clause construct. R14: filters.js - Show all phases calls viewSel.focus() after dispatching change, and the empty state's own Clear (resolved once in page-state.js as norowClear, beside the other empty-state refs, which keeps the refresh() slice query-free for the scale and tv-r2b pins) focuses #audit-view. Gate es1/es2 blur first, then check document.activeElement === #audit-view. R15: WIRED_CHIP_ATTRS is hoisted beside `source`, and the empty-state block and the Clear block both read it. The empty-state block now builds presses from it: each chip alone, the search alone (term = an archived phase id, else the first phase's), the search with each chip, and from/to set to a single day at each end of the date inputs' min/max. es0 asserts all three kinds ran. R9: the ceiling label says 'at least ${1 - STACK_CEILING_SHARE} of the screen'. Prose: the _report_html.py docstring and the gate comments that said 'sticky above 52rem' now name the short-screen arm, and ui/report/README.md notes the badge basis and the focus hand-off. Followers: examples/report.sh (acme html/md + docs/index.html), docs/demo-large.html per --how, and node tools/capture-screenshots.mjs (report shots + captured-at.json) were all refreshed. check-rendered-artifacts --before-commit says 3 artifacts match a fresh render. The layout baseline's relative arm still measures the recorded 30%/76%, so report-layout-baseline.json needs no re-recording. Gate run times: acme and demo about a minute each, and the live 166-phase plan about 19 minutes; that live leg was already that slow and is dominated by the Clear block's reloads, not the new presses (one refresh measured 3ms there). Dependants: the generated pages (docs/index.html, demo-large.html, the acme html) are re-rendered; _ui_theme.py and _ui_theme_lints.py still pass (test__ui_theme*, 6/6 suite files green); _report_ui.py assembly is unchanged; tests/test__report_html.py and tests/test__report_page.py are green; test__refs.py is green after the screenshot recapture; layout-baseline.mjs is unchanged and its consumer is green; date-range.js clearAll() is unchanged, and the new focus listener sits beside it. Out of scope and now slightly stale: plugins/audit/scripts/report/_report_page.py:509, a comment saying the header row is 'sticky above 52rem' without the new under-32rem-tall arm; it is not in my files, so I left it.
